screen.alkahest.journal.page.0:
My first notes

I shall begin with a cauldron, water and fire. On the map I can trace how my thoughts connect. I drag the background, select a node and scroll long notes with the wheel.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.1:
My cauldron

I need a cauldron, four copper ingots at the sides and three stones below. Under it I can place a lit campfire, fire, lava or magma, then fill it with a water bucket.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.2:
Brewing

I can use ingredients on the cauldron or throw them into the water. It holds six items. An empty hand or wand starts brewing; sneak-use empty-handed returns ingredients. Heated water alone becomes salt after 20 seconds.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.3:
My recipes

Coal and a bottle purify water; two flowers and food make paste. Gunpowder or blaze powder with redstone makes fire dust. Spider eye and cactus make caustic slime.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.4:
Distillation

I need six copper ingots, two glass blocks and a furnace for the distillery. Organic matter takes a minute. With an empty hand I can check progress and collect crystals or ash.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.5:
Reagents

If I right-click slime with fire dust in my inventory, I get napalm; caustic slime and gunpowder make an acid bomb. I can throw them, but I should be careful: they can hurt me too.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.6:
Essences and monocle

For a monocle I put a glass pane and an Ordo crystal in a heated cauldron with water, in either order; I may add a gold ingot. If a hypothesis is active, the experiment consumes the ingredients and gives no monocle: I must brew again. Equipped, it shows item essences. A stick and primal crystal make a wand.
